title: Open the System Report

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0; ported by reference (our own instruction, setup and checks; no source text copied)
source.changes: Instruction written in our own words. Setup quits System Settings as the source does, and also quits System Information and puts Finder in front, so a System Report window left by an earlier run can't pass. The check is the source's full-score one (System Information is the app in front), read through apps.list by bundle id instead of a System Events process name; the source's partial scores (an About window, System Settings in front) are dropped, as the bench scores pass or fail.

setup.why: Quit System Settings and System Information, so neither is open at the start.

argv: if application id "com.apple.systempreferences" is running then tell application id "com.apple.systempreferences" to quit
if application id "com.apple.SystemProfiler" is running then tell application id "com.apple.SystemProfiler" to quit

setup.why: Put Finder in front, so the app in front at the start is not the one the check wants.

instruction: Take me to the System Report page of this Mac.

checks.why: System Information (com.apple.SystemProfiler), the app the System Report button opens, is the app in front. Setup quit it and put Finder in front, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Quit System Information and System Settings.

argv: if application id "com.apple.SystemProfiler" is running then tell application id "com.apple.SystemProfiler" to quit
if application id "com.apple.systempreferences" is running then tell application id "com.apple.systempreferences" to quit

oracle.why: Open System Information in front, as the System Report button does.
Give it a moment to come to the front.
